ambient_events: The ventilation exhales a cool, clean breath across the floor.
Weights clink and resettle on a rack no one is touching.
description: A private gym walled in glass, the city laid out grey and glittering forty metres down. Rubberised black flooring, a rack of chromed free-weights polished to a shine, and a bench-press station set beneath a run of full-height mirrors. The air is cool and filtered and smells faintly of eucalyptus. A towel, folded into a swan, waits on every station. Step in to the elevator.
name: Solenne Fitness Club
